prepared_case_policy: Create inputs for391 full2D stations,3 matched local2D,6 local3D baseline cases and2 wider local3D controls. No unbounded391-case execution is implied. Pilot gates must precede any full Bscan batch.

runtime_policy.memory_estimate: Lower bound from installed array shapes, fields float64, IDs uint32, rigid int8, real Debye histories float64; excludes PML, import temporaries and backend workspaces
